info.description: Site-level layout defaults — the baseline every page, row and column inherits unless a node overrides it

edit.label: Page
edit.description: Applies to the page as a whole: rhythm between top-level blocks and rows.

edit.label: Row
edit.description: Applies to every row: container width, space between columns, cell alignment.

edit.label: Column
edit.description: Applies inside every column cell: vertical rhythm and content alignment.
